Riya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — leadership wants single-line customer-facing dates for Console traffic controls (UI + API) and Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization). Can product share short lines + main caveats?

Sam (Product): Console traffic controls: private beta target 2026-05-20, public beta target 2026-06-24. Caveat: depends on quota backend cutover; risk of 1-week slip if rollback.

Carlos (Runtime): Quota cutover in staging, 4/5 services migrated. If staging rollback hits we'll slide by ~1 week. Flagging.

Maya (DevEx): I'll prepare a 2-paragraph FAQ and an SDK snippet. ETA: draft by Mon. Snippet preview: POST /v1/console/limits {"route":"checkout","rpm":2000}.

Sam (Product): Optimize recommendations: internal alpha early July, public beta mid-July; hosted-first, Dedicated planned for August (Q3). Recs include confidence score and safety flag if evals detect >1% regression.

Jordan (Sales): Holding outbound until FAQ. If docs hit Mon/Tue I can brief accounts Wed.

ci-bot: Integration tests queued for optimize-eval (id: 20260701-09). Estimated 45m.

Riya: Perfect — please add these lines to the roadmap doc and tag owners so I can share with customers.

Sam (Product): Done. Added roadmap entries and tagged @Maya and @Carlos; will update if staging migration slips.

Riya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
